title: Promote 9 Review
intro_html:
This promote moves wave 9 of the shared-building-blocks refactor onto staging: sign-in and admin access, the save and redirect pipeline behind every button form, character ownership and unlinking, and how page sections load. It also carries the account-takeover fix you approved, so a character that was unlinked or sold can never be signed into someone else's account.

Screens compare staging today with the same screen after this promote. Most of wave 9 is behind the scenes; those items are marked and explained in plain words.

What happens when you are happy

Answer the questions marked on this page (or say "as is"), and say go. Then wave 9 merges into development with its fixes, the promote to staging opens, Greptile and Verify run, and it merges once they are green.
